decisions.action: View event order ledger & financial state
decisions.expected_result: HTTP 200 OK; Orders dashboard visible; administration controls accessible
decisions.observed_result: Access granted; Orders ledger rendered; authenticated as admin@localhost

decisions.expected_result: HTTP 200 OK; Quota pool management controls rendered
decisions.observed_result: Access granted; Quota list displayed with capacity 10 and item associations

decisions.action: Attempt direct access to privileged event orders ledger
decisions.expected_result: HTTP 302 Redirect to /control/login/?next=...; Protected data hidden
decisions.observed_result: Access denied; Redirected to login (http://localhost:8345/control/login?next=/control/event/sqe/sqe2026/orders/); zero data disclosed

decisions.action: Attempt direct modification of quota boundaries
decisions.expected_result: Access blocked; Redirect to login authentication gate
decisions.observed_result: Access denied; Redirection to login enforced (http://localhost:8345/control/login?next=/control/event/sqe/sqe2026/quotas/1/)
